verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers CPU cores/clocks, NPU TOPS, and memory bandwidth, but contains no mention whatsoever of PCIe generation/lanes, storage interface specs, or external connectivity (USB/Thunderbolt/display outputs) — the exact I/O headroom details the story asks for. The vendor spec page is even noted to be unreadable by non-browser fetchers, and the recorded 'gap' item only calls out missing TDP/process node/max-memory, not I/O specs at all.
